title: Dry-run event payload (W3)
description: One dry run of a candidate (instructor, unit, mode) by a clearer. Carries references, check results and hashes only: the clearer's notes stay in the private store. A run counts only while environment_sha256 equals the hash of the unit's environment, failure catalogue and run sheet (units.environment_sha256). passed means every check passed, a failure from the unit's failure catalogue was injected and handled, and the fallback was exercised.

failure_injected.description: The failure_catalogue id that was injected, or null when none was

signoff_id.description: The clearer's sign-off that recorded this run
